text: You see Set, the Leader of Necropolis.
source_text: You see Set, the Leader of Necropolis.

text: There'd better be a killer reason for standin' in my shadow. Does 'next on the menu' ring a bell for ya . . . normie.
source_text:
There'd better be a killer reason for standin' in my
 shadow. Does 'next on the menu' ring a bell for ya . . .
 normie.

text: Oh, killer it is, no doubt. Obviously I've found the head, uh, man.
source_text:
Oh, killer it is, no doubt. Obviously I've found the
 head, uh, man.

text: Whoa, what happened to your face?
source_text: Whoa, what happened to your face?

text: Wow, you're pretty smart for a ghoul.
source_text: Wow, you're pretty smart for a ghoul.

text: Nuh-uh?
source_text: Nuh-uh?

text: Simple time. I'm Set. I'm in charge. Get it?
source_text: Simple time. I'm Set. I'm in charge. Get it?

text: According to my info you're just a second rate minion.
source_text: According to my info you're just a second rate minion.

text: Got it.
source_text: Got it.

text: Anything else I should know?
source_text: Anything else I should know?

text: Good.
source_text: Good.

text: What can I do for you?
source_text: What can I do for you?

text: What is that? Sucking up? Listen, walker, I don't do the deal with norms, so blowing smoke up the tail ain't going to get you head seat at the table.
source_text:
What is that? Sucking up? Listen, walker, I don't do
 the deal with norms, so blowing smoke up the tail
 ain't going to get you head seat at the table.

text: The smoke will be coming out a lotta holes when I'm through.
source_text:
The smoke will be coming out a lotta holes when I'm
 through.

text: My apologies. I wanted to make a good impression.
source_text: My apologies. I wanted to make a good impression.

text: Didn't mean nothin'.
source_text: Didn't mean nothin'.

text: [Groan] I'm gonna to eat you up and be singing that 'Happy Tummy' song. I got that happy tummy . . .
source_text:
[Groan] I'm gonna to eat you up and be singing that 'Happy Tummy'
 song. I got that happy tummy . . .

text: Fact-time, bitch? I'm gonna enjoy squeezing you.
source_text: Fact-time, bitch? I'm gonna enjoy squeezing you.

text: Whatever's in your holster better be bigger than your mouth . . . Unlikely as that is.
source_text:
Whatever's in your holster better be bigger than your
 mouth . . . Unlikely as that is.

text: Squeeze this...
source_text: Squeeze this...

text: Nuh-uh?
source_text: Nuh-uh?

text: Well. I see some potential here . . . heh . . . I have playmates for you, my sparkling normie. Punish the mutants at the water shed for me. Yeah, yeah, can do . . . yes?
source_text:
Well. I see some potential here . . . heh . . . I have playmates
 for you, my sparkling normie. Punish the mutants at the water shed for me.
 Yeah, yeah, can do . . . yes?

text: Uh, OK.
source_text: Uh, OK.

text: Nuh-uh.
source_text: Nuh-uh.

text: Excellent. Teach those mutants the last lesson, then amble back . . . Hmm. If I say to my ghouls to hold off you, the muties might hear and know. So I tell you what, it's favor-time. I keep shut. Got it?
source_text:
Excellent. Teach those mutants the last lesson, then
 amble back . . . Hmm. If I say to my ghouls to hold
 off you, the muties might hear and know. So I tell you what,
 it's favor-time. I keep shut. Got it?

text: Got it.
source_text: Got it.

text: What about the ghouls?
source_text: What about the ghouls?

text: Duh, ok!
source_text: Duh, ok!

text: Huh?
source_text: Huh?

text: Avoid my ghouls, if you like your skin on. Any of mine that can't stop a normie deserve last rest. Get by as you need.
source_text:
Avoid my ghouls, if you like your skin on. Any of mine that can't
 stop a normie deserve last rest. Get by as you need.

text: You eat my time! Cease to be, one way or the other!
source_text: You eat my time! Cease to be, one way or the other!

text: You have no idea whose shadow you stomp.
source_text: You have no idea whose shadow you stomp.

text: A second-rate minion. I know your boss. Not happy.
source_text: A second-rate minion. I know your boss. Not happy.

text: Neither do you.
source_text: Neither do you.

text: Sorry, I have an odd sense of humor.
source_text: Sorry, I have an odd sense of humor.

text: You walk for him? You're his sneak, straight? Here to skin me? Oh, I swear, you'll tombstone too.
source_text:
You walk for him? You're his sneak, straight? Here to skin me?
 Oh, I swear, you'll tombstone too.

text: Whoa, Don't misinterpret. I'm not his. I'm here to help.
source_text: Whoa, Don't misinterpret. I'm not his. I'm here to help.

text: Try it spaghetti face.
source_text: Try it spaghetti face.

text: It didn't sound it.
source_text: It didn't sound it.

text: I understand. He's my problem, too. Talk to me.
source_text: I understand. He's my problem, too. Talk to me.

text: The Necropolis was mine. Not an all-things-great, but a straight-place for my kind. Then the Master showed. He could've fragged me good, but it was easy for him to just stand some muties and keep an eye on.
source_text:
The Necropolis was mine. Not an all-things-great,
 but a straight-place for my kind. Then the Master
 showed. He could've fragged me good, but it was easy
 for him to just stand some muties and keep an eye on.

text: What can I do, and what will you do for me?
source_text: What can I do, and what will you do for me?

text: Sounds a bit out of my league. I'm outta this.
source_text: Sounds a bit out of my league. I'm outta this.

text: The Mutants at the water shed need dirt-naps. Makes my shadow grow. You slice 'em and rewards run to you. Info, too.
source_text:
The Mutants at the water shed need dirt-naps. Makes
 my shadow grow. You slice 'em and rewards run to
 you. Info, too.

text: Done.
source_text: Done.

text: Too much trouble. See ya around.
source_text: Too much trouble. See ya around.

text: You want employ, walker? Show me you can scuffle. Take down the mutants at the water shed. Show 'em the bad time and you're good.
source_text:
You want employ, walker? Show me you can scuffle.
 Take down the mutants at the water shed. Show 'em
 the bad time and you're good.

text: I'm on it.
source_text: I'm on it.

text: No way, spaghetti face.
source_text: No way, spaghetti face.

text: No. More questions?
source_text: No. More questions?

text: Ahhh, guess not. What can I do for you?
source_text: Ahhh, guess not. What can I do for you?

text: Yeah. Do find it difficult to floss?
source_text: Yeah. Do find it difficult to floss?

text: So funny my face hurts. Try again, and my Elites will juice you. Got it?
source_text:
So funny my face hurts. Try again, and my Elites will
 juice you. Got it?

text: Got it.
source_text: Got it.

text: I'm still a little unclear . . .
source_text: I'm still a little unclear . . .

text: Your face hurts alright.
source_text: Your face hurts alright.

text: My name's Set. Yours is World-a-hurt. Take a deal, I change your handle. Listening?
source_text:
My name's Set. Yours is World-a-hurt. Take a deal, I
 change your handle. Listening?

text: Sure. Beats bleeding all over your floor.
source_text: Sure. Beats bleeding all over your floor.

text: Naww. Bring on the goons.
source_text: Naww. Bring on the goons.

text: Uh-huh.
source_text: Uh-huh.

text: Nuh-uh!
source_text: Nuh-uh!

text: Stride to the water shed, dirt-nap the mutants there. Do it, you continue a walker. Don't, you rest.
source_text:
Stride to the water shed, dirt-nap the mutants there.
 Do it, you continue a walker. Don't, you rest.

text: You sound a little scared by these guys, want to talk about it?
source_text:
You sound a little scared by these guys, want to
 talk about it?

text: I'm easy. Deal.
source_text: I'm easy. Deal.

text: You look funny, and you talk funny.
source_text: You look funny, and you talk funny.

text: Well done. You've earned my sight, walker. Follow Garret for your reward. Now. I'm busy.
source_text:
Well done. You've earned my sight, walker. Follow
 Garret for your reward. Now. I'm busy.

text: OK. Thanks.
source_text: OK. Thanks.

text: That's it! Thanks, now get out?
source_text: That's it! Thanks, now get out?

text: Mom?
source_text: Mom?

text: Look before you squeak. You'll enjoy. Be a shame to anger me, now . . . that I'm happy.
source_text:
Look before you squeak. You'll enjoy. Be a shame to
 anger me, now . . . that I'm happy.

text: I apologize for my outburst, but I'm a little concerned here.
source_text:
I apologize for my outburst, but I'm a little concerned
 here.

text: Sorry, no problem.
source_text: Sorry, no problem.

text: Hey, I'm not settling for left-overs
source_text: Hey, I'm not settling for left-overs

text: [Groan] Yeah, yeah. Follow Garret, and be showing your pearly whites too. And don't fret, I keep a straight-word. The Master runs the twist.
source_text:
[Groan] Yeah, yeah. Follow Garret, and be showing your pearly whites too.
 And don't fret, I keep a straight-word. The Master runs the twist.

text: The Master?
source_text: The Master?

text: Ok, thanks.
source_text: Ok, thanks.

text: You don't watch your back, you'll wear his knife, he'll wear your skin. His mutants shadow the wasteland, especially south of here.
source_text:
You don't watch your back, you'll wear his knife, he'll wear your
 skin. His mutants shadow the wasteland, especially south of here.

text: If the Master is so strong, who can challenge him?
source_text: If the Master is so strong, who can challenge him?

text: He doesn't scare me.
source_text: He doesn't scare me.

text: He should.
source_text: He should.

text: Children of the Cathedral, cids of the Hub, even us Ghouls. No one can push his shadow now. But our light will be brighter next time. Ho-ho, yes.
source_text:
Children of the Cathedral, cids of the Hub, even
 us Ghouls. No one can push his shadow now. But our
 light will be brighter next time. Ho-ho, yes.

text: Good luck.
source_text: Good luck.

text: Follow Garret and get out.
source_text: Follow Garret and get out.

text: Right.
source_text: Right.

text: Frag off.
source_text: Frag off.

text: You can be left-overs. Leave now, without your reward, or you're on the table tonight.
source_text:
You can be left-overs. Leave now, without your
 reward, or you're on the table tonight.

text: If that's the way you want it.
source_text: If that's the way you want it.

text: Frag off.
source_text: Frag off.

text: No word runs to my ear about the water shed mutants ceasing to breathe. Major to my plans. Tell me it's a problem buried.
source_text:
No word runs to my ear about the water shed
 mutants ceasing to breathe. Major to my plans. Tell
 me it's a problem buried.

text: Oh, yeah. No big deal, everything's been taken care of. Trust me.
source_text:
Oh, yeah. No big deal, everything's been taken care of.
 Trust me.

text: Nope, still working on it.
source_text: Nope, still working on it.

text: Nuh-uh.
source_text: Nuh-uh.

text: Ahhh, filling. Follow Garret to your reward.
source_text: Ahhh, filling. Follow Garret to your reward.

text: You steal my time with your lies. Leave my shadow before . . . die. Die! Just die!
source_text:
You steal my time with your lies. Leave my
 shadow before . . . die. Die! Just die!

text: Walk now. Deal with the mutants, and then return. Not before.
source_text:
Walk now. Deal with the mutants, and then
 return. Not before.

text: Caught by mine, huh? I gave you the straight on them. Now you pay. No credit.
source_text:
Caught by mine, huh? I gave you the straight
 on them. Now you pay. No credit.

text: I am Set. Why do you tread my shadow?
source_text: I am Set. Why do you tread my shadow?

text: I am the bringer of death. Fall to your knees and beg for mercy.
source_text:
I am the bringer of death. Fall to your knees and beg
 for mercy.

text: I am the bringer of death. Fall to your knees and beg for mercy . . . Or give me a sandwich, I'm pretty hungry.
source_text:
I am the bringer of death. Fall to your knees and beg
 for mercy . . . Or give me a sandwich, I'm pretty hungry.

text: I'm here to see the boss. That you?
source_text: I'm here to see the boss. That you?

text: Whoa, major case of acne!
source_text: Whoa, major case of acne!

text: Uhh, ahdunno.
source_text: Uhh, ahdunno.

text: Normies. If you caused the trembles in me, would my gates be this open?
source_text:
Normies. If you caused the trembles in me,
 would my gates be this open?

text: I've killed ghouls. I've killed mutants. I've killed things that you couldn't even imagine. Nobody gets in my way.
source_text:
I've killed ghouls. I've killed mutants. I've killed
 things that you couldn't even imagine. Nobody gets in
 my way.

text: How about a face lift . . . It'll look good on my wall.
source_text: How about a face lift . . . It'll look good on my wall.

text: You topped those at the watershed. I find that filling. For that, I'll give words. Then we walk opposite.
source_text:
You topped those at the watershed. I find that
 filling. For that, I'll give words. Then we walk
 opposite.

text: Why don't we just 'walk opposite' now?
source_text: Why don't we just 'walk opposite' now?

text: Works for me.
source_text: Works for me.

text: A warn. The South makes a big dog whimper and tuck tail. If ideas dance in your skull, I make big dogs play dead. On the other, you clean-wiped the shed. Garret will walk you to gratitude.
source_text:
A warn. The South makes a big dog whimper and
 tuck tail. If ideas dance in your skull, I make
 big dogs play dead. On the other, you clean-wiped
 the shed. Garret will walk you to gratitude.

text: Laughter comes hard here. You clean-wiped the shed?
source_text:
Laughter comes hard here. You clean-wiped the
 shed?

text: That's the fact.
source_text: That's the fact.

text: Oh, no. Wasn't me.
source_text: Oh, no. Wasn't me.

text: My wrong, your loss. Work grows, you should walk now.
source_text:
My wrong, your loss. Work grows, you should walk
 now.

text: Ah, yes. No tracks in the sand. Good. Filling. Walk with Garret to gratitude.
source_text:
Ah, yes. No tracks in the sand. Good. Filling. Walk
 with Garret to gratitude.

text: I cast the shadow. If that's the lot, remove yourself.
source_text: I cast the shadow. If that's the lot, remove yourself.

text: I'm here to collect the bounty for some mutants.
source_text: I'm here to collect the bounty for some mutants.

text: Thanks, I think I will be going.
source_text: Thanks, I think I will be going.

text: It'd be faster if I removed you.
source_text: It'd be faster if I removed you.

text: Workable. Follow Garret to gratitude, then walk another path.
source_text:
Workable. Follow Garret to gratitude, then walk
 another path.

text: Reasons for aggressions? Walk and mine will stand. Talk and mine will move.
source_text:
Reasons for aggressions? Walk and mine will stand.
 Talk and mine will move.

text: Sorry, bad attempt at humor.
source_text: Sorry, bad attempt at humor.

text: 'Bout time. Getting bored waiting for your face to clear up.
source_text: 'Bout time. Getting bored waiting for your face to clear up.

text: Ahh, the thinker-normie. You killed those at the shed, yes? Came for reward?
source_text:
Ahh, the thinker-normie. You killed those at the
 shed, yes? Came for reward?

text: Uh-huh
source_text: Uh-huh

text: Nuh-uh, me came kick ugly-butt.
source_text: Nuh-uh, me came kick ugly-butt.

text: Now is bad. Walk.
source_text: Now is bad. Walk.

text: I deserve some information.
source_text: I deserve some information.

text: How about I walk on your face?
source_text: How about I walk on your face?

text: Got it.
source_text: Got it.

text: Nuh-uh?
source_text: Nuh-uh?

text: Fine. Fast. What?
source_text: Fine. Fast. What?

text: You wouldn't do the mutants yourself. I ask myself why? Answer, someone has you scared. Why?
source_text:
You wouldn't do the mutants yourself. I ask myself
 why? Answer, someone has you scared. Why?

text: Why'd you need me to kill the mutants? Why not use your ghouls?
source_text:
Why'd you need me to kill the mutants? Why not use
 your ghouls?

text: How in the hell can you call all this crap a reward?
source_text: How in the hell can you call all this crap a reward?

text: I don't tremble. Use the tools of the time. You're used, you're rewarded, you're walking.
source_text:
I don't tremble. Use the tools of the time. You're
 used, you're rewarded, you're walking.

text: You're bluffing.
source_text: You're bluffing.

text: If you say so.
source_text: If you say so.

text: I think that's a threat!
source_text: I think that's a threat!

text: You don't even read the lines. Unless Necropolis is forever your home to be, walk. I have no time for a foolish blood-bag.
source_text:
You don't even read the lines. Unless Necropolis
 is forever your home to be, walk. I have no time for a
 foolish blood-bag.

text: How 'bout your own body-bag?
source_text: How 'bout your own body-bag?

text: Got it.
source_text: Got it.

text: Bite me.
source_text: Bite me.

text: With pleasure . . .
source_text: With pleasure . . .

text: No bluff, no twist. The Master does not tremble me. Walk. Your welcome has.
source_text:
No bluff, no twist. The Master does not tremble
 me. Walk. Your welcome has.

text: Thanks for your time.
source_text: Thanks for your time.

text: Think smokin' you will bring back my welcome? Works for me.
source_text:
Think smokin' you will bring back my welcome?
 Works for me.

text: Why send a ghoul for a child's work? Leave me.
source_text:
Why send a ghoul for a child's work?
 Leave me.

text: I'm weary. You're gone.
source_text: I'm weary. You're gone.

text: Sow and weep! I want you dead! Dead!
source_text: Sow and weep! I want you dead! Dead!

text: I spy your twist and it causes one of us pain. Short-list choice: Remove the mutants or die.
source_text:
I spy your twist and it causes one of us pain.
 Short-list choice: Remove the mutants or die.

text: I'll get right to it.
source_text: I'll get right to it.

text: It's a bigger list. #3 is: What if I twist off your head instead?
source_text:
It's a bigger list. #3 is: What if I twist off
 your head instead?

text: Still in my shadow? Why do normie tongues waggle and take the movement from their bones? Clear-time, walk now.
source_text:
Still in my shadow? Why do normie tongues waggle
 and take the movement from their bones? Clear-time, walk now.

text: Your presence means?
source_text: Your presence means?

text: Not much, just spreading the news that the Master is dead.
source_text:
Not much, just spreading the news that the Master
 is dead.

text: Ran out of butt to kick and thought of your face.
source_text: Ran out of butt to kick and thought of your face.

text: Huh. Master go boom.
source_text: Huh. Master go boom.

text: You mean dead?
source_text: You mean dead?

text: Uh-huh.
source_text: Uh-huh.

text: Warm. Filling. Your needs are my desires. Name them.
source_text:
Warm. Filling. Your needs are my desires. Name
 them.

text: Need some info on the Vats.
source_text: Need some info on the Vats.

text: I could use some more weapons and equipment.
source_text: I could use some more weapons and equipment.

text: No Thanks.
source_text: No Thanks.

text: Need stuff.
source_text: Need stuff.

text: Naww.
source_text: Naww.

text: Some of mine slipped the bonds. Worked that mutant task.
source_text:
Some of mine slipped the bonds. Worked that
 mutant task.

text: What did they say?
source_text: What did they say?

text: Mutants, huh? I'll probably need more guns.
source_text: Mutants, huh? I'll probably need more guns.

text: Big northwest, far from life. Busy with guards and tricky steering. If that's your path, walk it tight with my thoughts.
source_text:
Big northwest, far from life. Busy with guards
 and tricky steering. If that's your path, walk it tight with my thoughts.

text: Garret will pass what's available.
source_text: Garret will pass what's available.

text: You. Vanished our water processor chip. Exchanged it . . . for your life!
source_text:
You. Vanished our water processor chip. Exchanged
 it . . . for your life!

text: We both need working chips. Apparently there is only one. Is there another method we haven't thought about?
source_text:
We both need working chips. Apparently there is only
 one. Is there another method we haven't thought about?

text: I needed the chip to save my own vault. Sorry.
source_text: I needed the chip to save my own vault. Sorry.

text: Will sorry do?
source_text: Will sorry do?

text: Want it back?
source_text: Want it back?

text: Uhh?
source_text: Uhh?

text: A path, perhaps. An alternate pump exists, but not its actions. None of mine can breathe that life.
source_text:
A path, perhaps. An alternate pump exists, but not
 its actions. None of mine can breathe that life.

text: Perhaps I should take a look at the pump.
source_text: Perhaps I should take a look at the pump.

text: Too bad. Guess you're going thirsty.
source_text: Too bad. Guess you're going thirsty.

text: Garret will walk you. Revive the pump, keep the chip.
source_text:
Garret will walk you. Revive the pump, keep the
 chip.

text: Thanks.
source_text: Thanks.

text: I'll drink from you warm, then take from you cold.
source_text: I'll drink from you warm, then take from you cold.

text: I don't have it on me.
source_text: I don't have it on me.

text: How 'bout eating dirt instead.
source_text: How 'bout eating dirt instead.

text: Then die before mine!
source_text: Then die before mine!

text: Ideas will not matter to you again.
source_text: Ideas will not matter to you again.

text: I take it that's a 'no?'
source_text: I take it that's a 'no?'

text: Your price is to belong to Necropolis forever.
source_text: Your price is to belong to Necropolis forever.

text: Kind of expensive. How 'bout I remove you from office instead?
source_text:
Kind of expensive. How 'bout I remove you from office
 instead?

text: Nuh-uh!
source_text: Nuh-uh!

text: For the chip, you may walk.
source_text: For the chip, you may walk.

text: Gotcha! I don't have it anymore!
source_text: Gotcha! I don't have it anymore!

text: OK, here it is.
source_text: OK, here it is.

text: I'd rather see you dead.
source_text: I'd rather see you dead.

text: [Set passes the water chip to a ghoul, who runs off with it.]  If your shadow touches Necropolis again, it will merge forever.
source_text:
[Set passes the water chip to a ghoul, who runs
 off with it.]  If your shadow touches Necropolis again, it will
 merge forever.

text: As said . . .
source_text: As said . . .

text: Stated before . . .
source_text: Stated before . . .

text: Don't do the deal with normies.
source_text: Don't do the deal with normies.

text: Natter to Garret. My time flies.
source_text: Natter to Garret. My time flies.

text: Is your head empty?
source_text: Is your head empty?

text: Yours is the only benefit. This exchange lacks.
source_text: Yours is the only benefit. This exchange lacks.

text: Thoughts not in my possession
source_text: Thoughts not in my possession

text: The time is wrong. Evening is proper for your shadow.
source_text: The time is wrong. Evening is proper for your shadow.

text: Guards! Seize the norm!
source_text: Guards! Seize the norm!

text: Guards, end this annoyance!
source_text: Guards, end this annoyance!

text: His meaning has no place here. None.
source_text: His meaning has no place here. None.

text: The future. Survival anywhere. We surpass the norms.
source_text: The future. Survival anywhere. We surpass the norms.

text: An error of the world. A blot on my sight. I hate every facet.
source_text: An error of the world. A blot on my sight. I hate every facet.

text: Where your shadow lies. My home. My rule. A place where strength grows.
source_text:
Where your shadow lies. My home. My rule. A place where strength
 grows.

text: The beginning. World to ashes, ashes to growth. Our life.
source_text: The beginning. World to ashes, ashes to growth. Our life.

text: Misguided ideals. Nothing to my sight, nothing at all.
source_text: Misguided ideals. Nothing to my sight, nothing at all.

text: Many of yours. Some useful, but too many twists.
source_text: Many of yours. Some useful, but too many twists.

text: Relics. We surpass, they don't know. Their sight is narrow, only what they believe.
source_text:
Relics. We surpass, they don't know. Their sight is narrow, only what
 they believe.

text: Center of the Necropolis water supply. Poisoned by presence of mutants. Makes me empty to think on it.
source_text:
Center of the Necropolis water supply. Poisoned by presence of
 mutants. Makes me empty to think on it.

text: Provides what is needed.
source_text: Provides what is needed.

text: Beneath my thoughts.
source_text: Beneath my thoughts.

text: Not in my thoughts.
source_text: Not in my thoughts.

text: Simple time. I'm Set. I'm in charge. Get it?
source_text: Simple time. I'm Set. I'm in charge. Get it?

text: Thoughts not in my possession
source_text: Thoughts not in my possession

text: Beneath my thoughts.
source_text: Beneath my thoughts.

text: Not in my thoughts.
source_text: Not in my thoughts.

text: Master
source_text: Master

text: Ghouls
source_text: Ghouls

text: Mutants
source_text: Mutants
